verdicts.why: Marvel Zombies#1: the zombie Okoye keeps her mind and, as Wanda's scion, leads a horde including the zombie Captain America and Hawkeye against the North Institute; she takes Hawkeye back under the queen's control. Enemy becomes leader.
In Marvel Zombies#4 the zombie Wasp only fights Spider-Man and Scott in the same Paris horde; nothing passes between her and the Zombie Avengers, and sharing a battle is not a stage.
'The Cure' (#9): Warren backs Dr. Adler's cure, and Cable ambushes him and learns Adler has moved to Muir Island; Cable is after Apocalypse's whereabouts. They meet long before X-Men '97.
Banshee first appears in Phoenix Saga Part II (#30, S3E4), where Marvel Database cites him as Moira's fiance helping run the Muir Island center while Xavier rests there; well before #56.
'Time Fugitives' Part II (#21): Beast makes a vaccine from Wolverine's antibodies against Apocalypse's plague, and Apocalypse escapes rather than pursue the X-Men. A clash before #35.
X-Men '97#1 ends with Magneto revealing Xavier's will gives him control of the X-Men; Beast serves on the team he leads (#2 onward). Allies become leader and team member.
'Rise of Apocalypse' Part 2 (#14): Beast builds a time device from Ship's parts, Magneto sends the others back to the 1990s, then Apocalypse kills Magneto. A real new turn and a death.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#14
value.text: Sinister has the brainwashed Morph sabotage the Danger Room, and Beast is nearly killed.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Nearly kills Beast with a Danger Room trap.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Nearly killed by Sinister's Danger Room trap.

verdicts.why: Real early clash: in 'Till Death Do Us Part' Part I (#14) Sinister, using the brainwashed Morph, nearly kills Beast by sabotaging the Danger Room. But Beast's escape is in Part II (#15), so it can't be told at #14.

X-Men '97#1: the X-Men find Trask hiding at a Sahara junkyard, destroy his Sentinels and a Master Mold, and capture him; Marvel Animated says his Sentinels faced off against the X-Men. After Master Mold turned on him (#13), he commands Sentinels again.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#3
value.text: At a missile base, Magneto easily beats Scott, Storm and Wolverine, and he declares the X-Men his enemies.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Xavier's old friend, who easily beats Scott at a missile base.
value.on_b_card_about_a: An X-Man Magneto easily beats at a missile base.

verdicts.why: They meet and clash in 'Enter Magneto' (#3): at the missile base Magneto easily disables Cyclops, Storm and Wolverine, and the episode ends with him declaring the X-Men his enemies. The connection starts there, not at #76 (the Graduation Day truce is a later event).

value.title: X-Men '97#7
value.text: Terrified after the massacre on Genosha, Trask falls to his death, and hidden programming turns him into a human-Sentinel hybrid until Cable stops him with an EMP.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Trask's creations, which in the end make him one of them.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Their maker, turned into a human-Sentinel hybrid.

verdicts.why: A death is a stage: in X-Men '97#7 Trask, hunted and terrified after the Sentinels' massacre on Genosha, is dropped to his death, and hidden programming turns him into a human-Sentinel hybrid until Cable stops him. The machines he built take him over, against his will.
X-Men '97#4 'Motendo': Mojo pulls Jubilee and Roberto into a game of her old adventures; with Abscissa's help they beat him and return. A new clash after TAS#36.

'No Mutant Is an Island' (#34): grieving Jean, Cyclops lashes out at Xavier and throws his uniform at his feet, then returns with renewed faith in Xavier's ideals. A falling-out and reconciliation with no stage.

value.title: X-Men: The Animated Series#11
value.text: Bishop crashes into Xavier's mansion to stop the X-Men. Xavier keeps Wolverine from killing him and reads his memories of the future.
value.on_a_card_about_b: A time traveler whose memories Xavier reads after he attacks the mansion.
value.on_b_card_about_a: Reads Bishop's memories of the future and spares him.

verdicts.why: The connection starts earlier than #55: in 'Days of Future Past' Part I (#11) Bishop crashes into the mansion to stop the X-Men, and Xavier stops Wolverine from killing him and scans his memories of the future; they then fight Nimrod together. The 1959 rescue (#55) is a later event.

'Enter Magneto' (#3): Magneto easily disables Cyclops, Storm and Wolverine at the missile base; Storm then short-circuits the launched missiles and drops them in the water. They clash long before X-Men '97#2.
'Enter Magneto' (#3): Magneto easily disables Cyclops, Storm and Wolverine and gives them a message for Xavier. The connection starts here, long before X-Men '97#9.
X2: Scott collapses crying on Logan as Jean dies, and in Xavier's study Logan tells Scott that Jean made a choice and it was him. The rivalry turns to friendship (fandom: former rival, friend).
The Last Stand: Logan tells Scott he covered for him and urges him to move on; Scott goes to Alkali Lake and is killed, and Logan and Storm find his glasses. A death is a stage.

The Last Stand: Logan and Storm find an unconscious Jean at Alkali Lake and bring her home; the Phoenix escapes, kills Xavier, leaves with Magneto and later attacks everyone at Alcatraz. Fellow X-Men become enemies.

Days of Future Past: McCoy helps foil Mystique's attempt on Trask in Paris, then fights Magneto when he tries to kill her, letting her escape. A real earlier stage than Apocalypse. (Note for the owner: First Class, not in the focus, already has Hank make a cure from Raven's DNA, which she refuses.)
A ten-second brush-off in a bar where Logan tells Charles and Erik off; nothing develops and no kind fits, so it carries no meaning as a connection. Their connection starts at X-Men (2000).

The Origins stage carries the X-Men (2000) text. In Origins James flees with his elder half-brother Victor, they fight through a century of wars, Victor's violence drives Logan out of Team X, Logan hunts him after Kayla's apparent death, and they fight Weapon XI together.
Deadpool & Wolverine: Sabretooth, one of Cassandra Nova's henchmen, recognizes Wolverine, challenges his half-brother and is decapitated by him. A death is a stage.

Deadpool & Wolverine: after Sabretooth dies Pyro has Toad knock them out and takes them to Cassandra Nova; in the assault on her lair Pyro shoots Nova and Wolverine punches him unconscious. Student becomes enemy.
X-Men: Apocalypse: Stryker's forces take the captives to his base, where Scott, Jean and Kurt free them using Stryker's experiment Weapon X (Logan), whose memories Jean partly restores.

The stage sits at the show's start, but running away together is S1#10 and Alex reassuring Chase about Gert is during the Topher questioning in S2; 'fellow runaway' also gives away #10. In #1 they reunite and uncover PRIDE.
Companion to the stage 0 fix: in S1#10 Alex steals a Church van, Chase and Molly rescue Karolina, and the group leaves home together as the Runaways.

S2#13 (#23): Jonah himself, in Victor's body, brings Karolina to the Stein Mansion, shrugs off Chase's inhibitor pods and blasts Janet, Chase and Karolina into the Healing Algorithm. His family is not who captures them.

Runaways S3#4: Chase shoots the Magistrate and pins him with a blade, but the Magistrate says he wants Chase to watch the light leave his father's eyes, and Chase lets go and is overtaken. A new clash after the last stage.

S1#5 'Kingdom' flashback: Jonah offers to buy Geoffrey's Compton land and Geoffrey insists on being his partner; Geoffrey then carries out PRIDE's sacrifices to restore Jonah. The tie starts well before the S2 kidnapping.

Runaways S3#4: Nico's spell makes the Magistrates and their hosts vanish, and the Magistrate is expelled from Victor's body; Victor, himself again, is in the Dark Dimension next. The last stage leaves Jonah wearing his body.
S1#7 'Refraction': having learned of Victor's cancer, Janet tells Robert 'Goodbye, Robert' and tells Leslie she will end the affair; it is never resumed. A romance ending is a turn.

value.title: Cloak & Dagger#18
value.text: Evita marries Baron Samedi to bring Tyrone back from the Dark Dimension, giving up her chance at love. Afterward she keeps her distance from him.
value.on_a_card_about_b: Marries Baron Samedi to bring Tyrone back, then keeps her distance.
value.on_b_card_about_a: The young man Evita gives up love to save.

verdicts.why: Real turn in S2#8 (#18): Evita gives herself to Baron Samedi in marriage for Tyrone's safe return, losing her right to love, and keeps her distance from him after. But no source says she opens the way into the Dark Dimension (Tandy and Brigid go in).
Andre kills Chantelle in her shop, and in S2#8 (#18) Tyrone and the others go to the Fusilier store and find her dead. A death is a stage.

Malick sat on the World Security Council, not inside S.H.I.E.L.D. (the 'moles within S.H.I.E.L.D.' are Pierce and Garrett), and on screen he only says he hoped it might be Pierce but he was bloodthirsty (AoS S3#9). The fix removes the false part and keeps the tie.

Brave New World: Betty has refused her father's calls; she finally answers and agrees to a walk, and after he is locked in the Raft she visits him and they agree to sit and talk. A reconciliation after the estrangement.
Civil War, Lagos: Crossbones grabs Black Widow by the hair, fights her atop an armored truck, tells her he no longer feels pain, then locks her in it and drops a grenade in.
Endgame: in the 2012 Stark Tower elevator Rumlow refuses to give Steve the scepter until Steve whispers 'Hail Hydra', then hands it over. Something passes between them after the last stage.
